summary: Iteration 120: tested (a) Navbar split into sub-components, (b) httpOnly cookie auth (login/me/refresh/logout, browser flow), (c) anti-spam lead regression, (d) array-key fix regression across product-family pages. Backend cookie auth is fully working (15/16 pytest passed). Navbar refactor works perfectly (all dropdowns, families, More menu, theme toggle, mobile drawer, nav routing, zero JS errors). CRITICAL: the sed-based 'array key stability' change introduced 27 ReferenceErrors (key={i}/key={feature}/key={spec} referring to undeclared variables), crashing 14 public pages to a blank screen (all 4 SignaTouch pages, PixelVue landing + all /pixelvue/:slug product pages, NaturaTex, /naturatex/holoveil, /lumimorph/elite, /lumimorph/grande, /glassmorph/smart-film, /glassmorph/led-film, /glassmorph/media-glass). eslint no-undef confirms every location.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" in backend/.env combined with allow_credentials=True -> responses send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Allow-Credentials: true, which browsers reject for credentialed (cookie) requests. Works today only because frontend and API share the same preview origin; will break cookie auth for any real cross-origin deployment. Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit FRONTEND_URL.

Brute-force limiter is 5 attempts / 60s window (utils.py login_limiter), not the 10/hr mentioned in the request. Lockout verified working (429 returned, valid creds also blocked while locked) — flagging only the doc/config mismatch.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix all 27 undefined key references introduced by the sed pass. Run `npx eslint src/pages --rule '{no-undef:error}'` or `python /app/tests/scan_key_mismatch.py` for the exact list. Either re-add the (item, i) index param or use a content-based key from the correct map variable (e.g. key={app.name}, key={faq.q}, key={spec.label}). Note some files also use `i` inside className/animation delay, so re-adding the index param is the safest fix.

Re-run eslint on the whole frontend after fixing — 135 lint problems exist (no-undef + react/no-unescaped-entities + react/no-unstable-nested-components in VirtualShowroom, AdminPixelVue, AdminProductFamilies, AdminSolutions).
Set backend CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit FRONTEND_URL instead of "*" since allow_credentials=True is now required for cookie auth.
Consider dropping the localStorage token fallback in AdminContext (blx_admin_token/blx_admin_refresh are still written), which negates the XSS protection the httpOnly cookies were added for.

rca_of_the_issue: The 'array key stability' change was applied with sed across signatouch/pixelvue/lumimorph/glassmorph/naturatex pages. sed substituted a fixed replacement (key={feature.title}, key={spec...}) regardless of the actual map callback variable, and in other files removed/never had the index param while key={i} (and i-based className/delay expressions) remained. Result: ReferenceError at render time, React unmounts the whole tree -> blank page with 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Reproduce: open https://product-detail-qa.preview.emergentagent.com/pixelvue — console shows 'i is not defined' from PixelVueProductPage/NaturaTexPage etc. Mitigation: restore the index param or use the correct map variable for keys, then verify with eslint no-undef.
